from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i,row in enumerate(o):
        while 0<=len(row)>0 and row[0]!=5: pass
        idx=row.index(5) if 5 in row else None
        if idx is None: continue
        j=idx+1
        n=len(row)
        while j<n and row[j]==bg: j+=1
        k=j
        while k<n and row[k]==bg: k+=1
        if k>n-1 or row[k]!=5:
            for c in range(j,k): o[i][c]=3
        else:
            for c in range(idx+1,j): o[i][c]=3
    return o
